headline: Sprouts Farmers Market Shares Plunge as Store Traffic Declines in Q3
summary: Sprouts Farmers Market published third-quarter 2026 results showing revenue growth alongside falling customer foot traffic. Shares of the grocery chain dropped sharply following the earnings call.
why: Sprouts Farmers Market is a major U.S. specialty grocery store chain focused on natural and fresh foods.

impacts.name: Sprouts Farmers Market, Inc.
impacts.why: Investor concern over declining customer traffic drove a sharp decline in the company's share price.

why_moved: Sprouts shares plunged due to investor anxiety over dropping store foot traffic despite top-line sales growth.
